producerTextNew.noAccess: You must be a teacher or admin to create writing activities.
producerTextNew.title: New writing activity
producerTextNew.subtitle: Create a writing task with assignment text, criteria, support words, and AI limits. Students create their own title in the writing room.
producerTextNew.saved: The writing activity has been saved.
producerTextNew.openLibrary: Open My content to assign it.

video.title: Instruction video
video.text: Space for a short video showing how to use the text builder.

frame.title: Frame
frame.text: Choose genre, language, level, progression, and approximate text length.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.text: Write the task, theme, criteria, and optional competence goals.

support.title: Support
support.text: Decide support words, AI use, and whether students can use images in the final product.

frame.title: Control
frame.subtitle: These choices control the student flow and which support is available.
frame.languageHelp: For now we use platform languages because templates, support words, and student flow are language-based.

genres.storyDescription: Narrative and descriptive writing with planning, writing room, and control room.

story.title: Creative text
story.subtitle: Assignment, theme, and criteria for narrative or descriptive writing.

criteria.title: Requirements and criteria
criteria.subtitle: One item per line. These are used in the student's control room and as a frame for AI support.

support.title: Support words and starters
support.subtitle: One word or sentence starter per line. The teacher can make support narrower or richer.

aiControl.title: AI control
aiControl.subtitle: Set clear limits before sharing. Students should think first and use AI as support.
aiControl.totalHelp: Applies to the whole activity for one student.
aiControl.sectionHelp: Applies to each writing or control field.

bottom.title: Text builder
bottom.summary: The activity is saved to My content and can be assigned to a space from there.

fields.goalsPlaceholder: Paste one competence goal per line.

progression.title: Progression
progression.subtitle: Choose how much structure students should meet in the process.
progression.guidedText: Students can move back and forth, while the rooms keep a clear order.
progression.freeText: Students can work more openly and move between rooms as needed.
progression.lockedText: The next step can be locked until students have written or submitted enough work.
